artworks.title: The Drinker, Front View
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.253.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a dynamic pose, with a hat, wearing a tunic and pants with stripes. The figure is holding a bottle and a cup. The background is a plain beige surface.

artworks.title: The Flageolet Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.253.a-d)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a character playing a musical instrument. The image features a figure with exaggerated features, such as a large hat adorned with leaves, a pronounced nose, and a hunched posture. The character appears to be walking while playing a woodwind instrument. The drawing is created with bold black lines on a beige background.

artworks.title: Duellist with Two Sabers
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of three prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.254.a-c)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding two swords in a fighting stance. The figure has exaggerated features, with a hunched back and a distorted face. The figure is standing on a flat surface, lunging forward with one leg bent and the other extended behind. The clothing includes a tunic with folds and stripes, and the swords are pointing in opposite directions. The style features sharp lines and a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Duellist with Sword and Dagger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of three prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.254.a-c)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a fencing stance, wearing historical clothing and holding a sword.

artworks.title: Cripple with Crutch and Wooden Leg
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of three prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.254.a-c)
artworks.description: This print shows a person in a crouched, forward-leaning position, using two sticks for support. The person has a grimacing expression, with a curved nose, a furrowed brow, and a slightly open mouth. They have short hair that sticks out from the back of a hooded garment they are wearing. One of their arms is curled up against their shoulder, while the other holds a wooden crutch. One of their legs is also supported by a wooden stick. The background of the print is plain paper.

artworks.title: The Masked Comedian Playing a Guitar
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.3 × 7.5 cm (2 1/2 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a character playing a stringed instrument. The figure is shown strumming a small, guitar-like instrument while leaning forward. It wears a mask with goggles and a long, beak-like nose, reminiscent of historical plague doctor outfits. The character is dressed in a costume with a long-sleeved garment, large buttons, and a feathered hat. The drawing features a monochrome palette with strong lines and hatching for shading and texture, conveying a sense of theatricality and playful eccentricity.

artworks.title: The Guitar Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.1 × 8 cm (2 3/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure playing a stringed instrument. The image depicts a stylized figure holding and playing a lute-like instrument. The character is drawn with exaggerated features, such as a large head and oversized hands. The figure is shown in a dynamic pose, seemingly engaging with the music produced by the instrument. The drawing style emphasizes bold, black outlines and detailed hatching to convey shadows and texture in the figure's clothing and skin.

artworks.title: The Hurdy-Gurdy Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of three prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.257.a-c)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crouched position, with their hand resting on one knee. The person has an aged face with deeply etched lines, a prominent nose, and a furrowed brow. They wear a distinctive large, rounded hat that covers most of their hair. The attire includes layered garments such as a long coat, loose-fitting pants, and shoes. The person appears to be holding a cylindrical object under their arm. The background is a lightly textured, blank surface.

artworks.title: The Bagpipe Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of three prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.257.a-c)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing upright. The person is slightly hunched and is clenching their hands together in front of them. The facial features include a pronounced nose and a furrowed brow with squinted eyes, wavy and disheveled hair, and an object resembling a trumpet accessory attached at the top. They wear a long tunic with buttons and tight-fitting, wrinkled pants or leggings. The attire is detailed with prominent lines for texture. The background is plain beige.

artworks.title: Man with Big Belly
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of three prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.257.a-c)
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of a rotund figure in historical clothing. The figure is standing in a slight off-balance position, leaning to the left. His facial features are exaggerated and round, with bushy eyebrows, a double chin, and a solemn expression. He has long, wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat with a plume. The figure is dressed in puffed sleeves, a doublet, knee-length breeches, and stockings. He is holding a large goblet or flask and has a sword at his waist. The shoes are pointed. The background is plain, emphasizing the whimsical appearance of the character.

artworks.title: The Hooded Cripple
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features curved and flowing lines forming an abstract figure resembling a man with a fish head. The head is elongated and has gills, a pointed snout, and whisker-like lines. The body is wrapped in a large coat with an oversized cuff. The figure is holding a walking stick, blending human posture and dress with the fish features.

artworks.title: The Hunchback with a Cane
artworks.medium: etching and engraving/one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.259.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoonish character in profile view, hunched over and leaning on a walking stick held in their right hand. They are taking a step forward with their left foot. The character has exaggerated facial features, including a large nose, prominent cheeks, and a slightly open mouth with a smirk. They wear a hat with a feather and loose-fitting clothing with buttons, and have a satchel or pouch draped over their front. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Drinker, Back View
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.259.a-d)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure doing a handstand. The figure is depicted as rotund, with exaggeratedly round form. The figure is in a handstand position with legs bent and arms supporting its weight. The figure is clothed in garments with horizontal lines, suggesting texture, and buttons can be observed on the sleeves. The lines are bold and confident, with thick outlines and visible crosshatching, giving the illustration a whimsical and cartoonish quality. The background is a plain, unadorned surface, focusing attention on the humorous posture and detailed costume of the figure.

artworks.title: The Hunchback with the Feathered Cap
artworks.medium: etching and engraving/one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.259.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a person seen from the back. The individual stands upright with their back to the viewer, their head turned slightly to the right. The person has curly hair cascading down the neck and ears, and they are wearing a large hat with a wide brim. The attire consists of a puffed, buttoned shirt with pronounced sleeves and knee-length, puffed trousers. A sword hangs from their waist, slightly touching the ground. The background is a plain, textured surface with no distinct features.

artworks.title: The Potbellied Man with the Tall Hat
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.259.a-d)
artworks.description: This illustration features a full-body depiction of a person standing upright. The individual is shown facing forward, with one arm resting on a cane and the other arm at their side. The person has distinctive facial features including a pronounced brow, a prominent nose, and a defined mustache. Their eyes appear focused and direct, and they have long hair flowing out from under a large, plumed hat. The person is wearing an outfit with puffed sleeves, a buttoned top, loose trousers, and sturdy shoes. A large sword is hanging from their side, and they are holding a cane. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed linework of the character.

artworks.title: Man Scraping a Grill
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a fantastical creature in profile walking to the left. The creature is in a dynamic pose, with one leg lifted off the ground and arms folded in front of its chest. It has exaggerated facial features, large drooping ears, and a full, bushy head of hair that extends into long, thin locks. The creature is wearing a textured coat and pants with gathered fabric at the cuffs, simple shoes, and is holding an object that resembles a string instrument or apparatus. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: The Violin Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure with exaggerated features, holding a violin and a bow. The character has large eyes, a prominent nose, a wide mouth, and long hair flowing from under a hat. The attire consists of a tunic or robe, wide-legged trousers, and shoes. The background is plain, and the image is rendered in monochromatic ink on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Man Preparing to Draw His Sword
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature-like figure in a hunched position, appearing to walk to the right. The figure has exaggerated facial features, long whiskers, messy hair covered by a large hat, and wears a loose tunic with a belt and shoes. They hold a stick-like object in one hand. The background is plain with sketchy lines indicating the ground, all rendered in a sketchy style on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Masked Man with Twisted Feet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a fantastical creature or character. This figure is standing with a confident and slightly leaning posture. The creature has exaggerated facial features, including a prominent hooked nose and bulging eyes, with long strands extending from the back of its head. It is wearing a simplistic, one-piece garment that fits snugly around its body, with visible stitching and folds. A sword is slung across the back, held in place by a belt at the waist, with the hilt visible on the right side of the figure. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Steamboat, Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a harbor scene with buildings on the distant shore, sailboats on the water, and a high horizon line. The artwork is created using delicate lines to depict the sky, water, and reflections. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between light and dark. In the foreground, there is a small object, while sailboats lead to the busy harbor.

artworks.title: Venetian Water-Carrier
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length sketch of a standing person wearing a long, flowing garment that covers their body. The person's head is covered with a veil or headscarf, and their facial features are softly sketched and slightly obscured by shading. The hair is not visible. There are no objects or jewelry visible. The background is neutrally shaded without distinct features, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Alderney Street
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with various buildings and urban activities. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, and many buildings and people are visible. The horizon is obscured by tall buildings in the background. The style is loose and sketchy, with fine lines indicating figures, buildings, and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia or pencil gray tones on an off-white background. Near the viewer, a person and a horse-drawn carriage are depicted. Further away, more figures and another carriage are shown, adding to the urban scene. The distant buildings are outlined with simple linear details.

artworks.title: Little Dordrecht
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy harbor scene with various figures and objects sketched intricately across the composition. The point of view is slightly elevated, allowing a view of the activity on the docks and the boats in the water. The horizon is in the upper third of the image with ship masts piercing the sky. The line work appears delicate and linear, possibly created through an etching technique. The color scheme consists mainly of sepia tones. Various figures are engaged in activities near wheelbarrow-like objects, with ships anchored in the waterway beyond. Thin lines in the distance suggest land or clouds against the sky.

artworks.title: A Sketch at Dieppe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a landscape with figures throughout. The horizon shows outlines of a bluff and buildings. The sketch uses light pencil lines on warm, sepia paper. Various figures are depicted in the foreground and background, along with some ships. The drawing has a calm atmosphere with minimal detailing.
